unresolved_questions: Parent chain depth and cycle safety in real configurations. This body has no guard and no trace was captured.

The machine ABI record cannot be promoted from worker level. Its conventions.confidence is UNKNOWN, its verdict is ABI_UNKNOWN, its conflicts[] still holds an unresolved inferred_vs_persisted entry, and it is generated by tools/reconstruction_tooling/abi_infer.py, which is out of bounds here. The three direct observations and the SDK prototype that support __thiscall are recorded, and the ABI check is expected to stay WARN.

The three-word parent identity raised by conflict TD-DATA-003: this body reads exactly one dword at +0x30, which the SDK types as a one-word intrusive_ptr, so this access path is not the three-word record the conflict describes, but the manager-side question is untouched here.

What the low byte of mProperties.mValueCompare is for. The SDK names the word mValueCompare, the body pushes its low byte as the helper's fourth argument, and 0x00612db0 never reads it, so this lookup mode has no effect on the binary search performed by this path. Whether another overload of the shared helper consumes it was not examined.

Whether any caller reads the upper 24 bits of EAX. Only AL is architecturally defined on the true path, the false path leaves a fully zeroed EAX, and the parent path forwards whatever the parent left, so a caller depending on more would be relying on an accident of this codegen.
Whether the receiver's elements are kept sorted. The binary search requires ascending first values, but nothing in this body maintains or verifies that, and no insert or sort body was analysed.

Whether the receiver's third argument slot at entry_ESP+0x10, which the derived record reports as observed, is really absent. The listing resolves every [ESP+n] read to entry_ESP+0x04 or entry_ESP+0x08, so the record's slot appears to come from its unmodelled linear ESP walk; confirming that requires a change to the generator.

Which concrete types are installed as parents. The base PropertyList vtable points slot +0x24 back at this function, so a base parent recurses, but App::DirectPropertyList's vtable was not read and whether any subtype overrides +0x24 is unexamined.
